# Entries live in posts/ and are added from the content panel (/admin/).

listing:

    grid-columns: 3
    sort: "date desc"

  - id: list-workshop
    contents: posts
    include: { tur: calistay }
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 3
    sort: "date desc"
    fields: [image, date, title, description]
  - id: list-announcement
    contents: posts
    include: { tur: duyuru }
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 3
    sort: "date desc"
    fields: [image, date, title, description]
date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
language:
  listing-page-no-matches: "no entries yet."
---
